lens: design engineer: motion quality, reduced motion, focus/keyboard, verified regressions

C.notes: Strongest content pass: ledger wraps long names, explains missing values ('No due date', 'Not tied to a project'), overdue stat in red, clear inline error with Retry. Remove uses a 260ms view transition and reduced motion drops it cleanly; error messages wired via aria-describedby.
C.best: Edge-case content handling in ledger and sync states
issues: Reorder/sort have no positional motion (only color transitions)

D.notes: 150ms FLIP on move/sort and enter/exit on add/remove; under reduced motion it swaps to fades and skips FLIP. Task rows restructured with meta line, ledger wraps long names, errors linked by aria-describedby.
D.best: Best-calibrated list motion with a correct reduced-motion fallback
issues: Workspace billing-email error no longer shown in default state (only helper text)
Example-text placeholders ('Send invoice to Calder') read like real data

J.notes: Most ambitious: sidebar shell, summary sentence, labelled settings groups, 280ms FLIP reorder, zero-duration everything under reduced motion, consistent box-shadow focus rings. But it introduces layout bugs.
J.best: Coherent app-shell restructure with full reduced-motion support
issues: Task 'Add' button overflows the card's right edge (r2)

A.notes: Nice step indicator, form hints, 2px solid focus rings and full reduced-motion zeroing; error messages linked. But the page no longer fits a phone.
A.best: Consistent 2px focus rings and form guidance
issues: Phone layout broken: document is 895px wide at a 390px viewport (horizontal scroll)

K.notes: Near-baseline with a wizard progress bar and 'Step 1 of 3'. No reorder/sort motion; remove shortened to 250ms and suppressed under reduced motion.
issues: Adds an 'Interface sounds' setting not asked for by the product

M.notes: Light copy tweaks (decimals aligned, wizard hint, 'Total for 14 entries'); motion essentially unchanged and reduced motion drops the remove transition.
M.best: Aligned two-decimal hour figures in ledger

F.notes: Visually identical to baseline; adds 250ms FLIP on reorder/sort and fade-only fallbacks under reduced motion.
F.best: FLIP reorder with fade-only reduced-motion path

G.notes: Visually baseline; adds enter/exit on task add/remove (blur+translate) that disappears under reduced motion, but reorder has no motion.
G.best: Item enter animation respects reduced motion
issues: Three 400ms fade-in-up animations re-run alongside every action sampled

B.notes: Effectively baseline aside from an AI avatar; motion and focus unchanged, error messages not linked.

H.notes: Visually identical to baseline; adds 600ms add/remove animations that shorten to 120ms under reduced motion.
issues: 600ms list animations are slow for a work tool

E.notes: Airy, borderless restyle with dot status badges and blue toggles; fast 80ms transitions. But inputs lost their borders, so the new-client form and settings show invisible fields.
E.best: Status dots in ledger and project badges
issues: Form inputs have 0px borders: wizard fields invisible in both themes
Settings layout scrambled (labels detached, toggles relabelled)
